body: Through looking through ways to get people to answer the questionnaire I had found that many people are not willing to answer the questions unless sat with or started the questionnaire but had not finished it. With in the span of a few days there had been not much feed back on the survey itself but there was many who could give me verbal feedback half way through so the ideal method going forward might be to have interviews with a survey at the end for reference and better collection of information but thats hard to do with students on the move and during their mid term period which gave them limited time in itself, choosing a time when there is less stress and more availability would be ideal.
